<documents>
<document id="plan-change">
ChangingˆyourˆplanˆYouˆcanˆmoveˆbetweenˆBasic,ˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcontactˆsupport,ˆthoughˆsupportˆcanˆmakeˆtheˆchangeˆforˆyouˆifˆyouˆask.ˆ##ˆUpgradingˆAnˆupgradeˆtakesˆeffectˆimmediately.ˆWeˆchargeˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆfullˆmonthlyˆfeeˆthatˆday,ˆandˆthatˆdayˆbecomesˆyourˆnewˆbillingˆdate.ˆYourˆnewˆlimits,ˆfeesˆandˆsavingsˆrateˆapplyˆfromˆthatˆmoment.ˆ##ˆDowngradingˆAˆdowngradeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆYouˆkeepˆyourˆcurrentˆplan'sˆfeaturesˆuntilˆthen.ˆWeˆdon'tˆrefundˆpartˆofˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆThingsˆtoˆcheckˆbeforeˆyouˆdowngradeˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆuseˆCushionˆandˆmoveˆtoˆBasic,ˆCushionˆswitchesˆoff.ˆAnyˆnegativeˆbalanceˆstillˆhasˆtoˆbeˆrepaid.ˆ-ˆYourˆSavingsˆPocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆdowngradeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆ-ˆAˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆReplacementsˆafterˆthatˆareˆplastic.ˆ-ˆIfˆthisˆisˆyourˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆandˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆlessˆthanˆ14ˆdaysˆago,ˆleavingˆtheˆpaidˆplanˆgetsˆyouˆaˆfullˆrefundˆofˆthatˆcharge.ˆSeeˆ"Refundsˆofˆplanˆfees".ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆhowˆoftenˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplans.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-interest-calc">
HowˆsavingsˆinterestˆisˆcalculatedˆInterestˆonˆSavingsˆPocketsˆisˆcalculatedˆeveryˆdayˆandˆpaidˆonceˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆcalculatedˆEachˆdayˆweˆworkˆoutˆinterestˆonˆtheˆbalanceˆinˆeachˆpocketˆatˆyourˆplan'sˆrate,ˆandˆitˆcompoundsˆdaily.ˆTheˆAPYˆalreadyˆincludesˆtheˆeffectˆofˆcompounding.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆpaidˆInterestˆforˆtheˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆeachˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth,ˆandˆshowsˆasˆ"Interest".ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆYourˆplan'sˆAPYˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆthatˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ##ˆChangingˆplansˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplans,ˆtheˆnewˆrateˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆInterestˆforˆearlierˆdaysˆinˆtheˆmonthˆusesˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆRateˆchangesˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆWeˆgiveˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆnoticeˆbyˆemailˆbeforeˆweˆlowerˆaˆrate.ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-renewal">
CardˆexpiryˆandˆrenewalˆWeˆmailˆaˆnewˆcardˆautomaticallyˆaboutˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆexpires.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangesˆTheˆrenewedˆcardˆhasˆtheˆsameˆcardˆnumber,ˆaˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆaˆnewˆsecurityˆcode.ˆMostˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoreˆyourˆcardˆgetˆtheˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆautomatically,ˆbutˆsomeˆdon't,ˆsoˆcheckˆyourˆsubscriptions.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆwhenˆitˆarrivesˆActivateˆtheˆnewˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆYourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆnewˆoneˆorˆuntilˆitˆexpires,ˆwhicheverˆcomesˆfirst.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆdoesn'tˆarriveˆCheckˆthatˆyourˆaddressˆinˆtheˆappˆisˆcurrent.ˆIfˆyourˆoldˆcardˆexpiresˆandˆtheˆnewˆoneˆstillˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆanotherˆoneˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆ##ˆNoˆrenewal?ˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆorˆunderˆreview,ˆweˆcan'tˆsendˆaˆrenewalˆcardˆuntilˆthat'sˆresolved.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
